criteria.name: artwork_craft
criteria.why: Per frame 7.5, 6.5, 6.5, 6.5, 7.0, 5.0, 6.0, 5.5, 6.5. All real renders with black skies; four frames carry a visible defect: 6's flat groove and seam, 8's floating front tyre and tablecloth cover, 7's flat columns and footer grass, 2's toy cars, aliasing and plate blank. 1 and 5 pass four of five showstopper questions; 9 is the greyest.

criteria.name: deck_coherence
criteria.why: Real devices; rotation passes; the worker cast flips between 1 and 4; the value track jumps at the close; the reliefs read as different stock; one skeleton on nine frames.

criteria.name: claim_integrity
criteria.why: Every numeral traces and the scoping is careful; held under 9 because the quotes rest on the run's own extraction.

criteria.name: story_and_stakes
criteria.why: What, who and where; a general stake with nothing to watch next.

criteria.name: sequence_and_momentum
criteria.why: Cover earns the swipe, 2 pays, 3 measures, 5 turns, 9 reverses the cover; 4, 6 or 7 could move.

criteria.name: voice
criteria.why: Clean and precise; a careful clerk rather than a Texan.

criteria.name: variety
criteria.why: A new world, palette and opening move; plan reliefs recur from no. 56.

one_sentence_fix: Conceive frame 6 as a physical object in the plant.

artwork_weakest_frames.problem: Flat groove, a seam, blocks owning a fifth of the width, label halos.
artwork_weakest_frames.fix: A 20 px milled groove with lit and shadowed walls, a near black plate, the relief at 1.5x.

artwork_weakest_frames.problem: The front tyre floats above its pad; tablecloth cover.
artwork_weakest_frames.fix: Pads under the tyre centres with contact; a raked windscreen line and the hem pulled in at the arches.

artwork_weakest_frames.problem: Flat columns; pads in black; footer grass.
artwork_weakest_frames.fix: W-section columns; stage the near column and pads; a scatter avoid over the footer.

artwork_weakest_frames.problem: Toy cars, aliasing, a plate blank, no lamp rows.
artwork_weakest_frames.fix: Supersample, delete the plate recess, tilt up to show a lit lamp row.
Stage the dark door so the wall falls off; leg casts under the flood.

artwork_weakest_frames.problem: The worker cast runs left against frame 1.
artwork_weakest_frames.fix: Read the key from the deck rig; weather the plinths.
